description: Applies one action to up to 100 orders named in ids: out_for_delivery marks each out for delivery and sends each customer the out-for-delivery message on WhatsApp (Starter plan and up; inside the chat’s 24-hour window only), assign gives each to the member in assignee_id (null takes it off), export_csv makes the courier’s CSV, and packing_slips makes one PDF with a page per order. Each order gets its own result, so one that is not found is skipped with its reason while the rest go through. A file comes back as a link that works for an hour. Each action needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that returns what would happen and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it acts.

assignee_id.description: For assign: a member’s usr_ id, or null to take the assignee off.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

name: bulk_update_orders
title: Update many orders
